newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE MONEY MARKET LIQUID, RATES MIXED.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE MONEY MARKET LIQUID, RATES MIXED.

text.p: Short-term trading rates on Zimbabwe's money market were quoted mixed in continued liquidity on Tuesday, dealers said.
"We're expecting a lot of maturities today so the market should continue flush," commented one dealer.
He said discount houses were taking up 91-day treasury bills from the central Reserve Bank at 19.60 percent and selling them back to the market at a steady 19.50 percent.
NCD bills maturing after 30, 60 and 90 days were being bought easier at 21 percent from 23 percent and their selling rate eased to 20.50 percent from 21.
Bankers acceptances were trading at 20.25 and 20 percent from 21 and 20 percent while call money edged up to 20 percent from 18 percent.
